title: D2P References
description: Pinned references. Every reference that leaves an aggregate names a concrete revision; a branch name, HEAD, 'latest' or a missing revision is not expressible (D2P-STR-011), and a different revision MUST NOT be substituted silently. The root accepts an artifact reference.

artifactRef.title: Artifact reference
artifactRef.description: Reference to one immutable revision of an artifact.

elementRef.title: Element reference
elementRef.description: Reference to an element inside a pinned artifact revision.

elementId.description: Stable element ID inside the revision's content document.

elementType.description: Expected kind of the element; a mismatch is D2P-REF-004.

derivedRef.title: Derived reference
derivedRef.description: Reference to a derived document (evaluation, report, snapshot, scene, print job, 3D scene snapshot, panel mesh result) or a record with a global own ID by that ID. 'digest' holds the target's resultDigest; for a geometry snapshot its geometryDigest; for a 3D scene snapshot its sceneDigest; for a target with none of these, its contentDigest (computed whether or not the target writes it out).

id.description: Own ID of the derived document.

digest.description: Digest of the target as described above. Required only where a member says so.

elementType.title: Element type
elementType.description: Kind of an element (extensible vocabulary): one of the registered 'd2p:' element types or an extension name.
